notes.title: Concept Demo 2 is ready for testing!
notes.content:
Hey there! 
I need a bit of help with my game ⁠loopido if you have a few minutes to spare.
Concept demo 2 is out to be tested [url=https://prettyflygames.itch.io/loopido]https://prettyflygames.itch.io/loopido[/url] and I would love some feedback on it.

I've realized that a puzzle platformer was a rather bad fit for this game as the puzzles became quite awkward so I decided to shift the focus more into just pure platforming. At the moment I'm starting to gravitate towards making a quite hard game with various wicked ways of killing the player and allowing them to overcome that (or just skip a level or two). You can see this in the new laser levels which are significantly harder than the older levels. I also riped the whole Be the world concept out for now, I might add a few levels for that mode, but I won't have a dedicated mode for it. 

I'm really interested in what you think about the game and any suggestion you might have to improve it.
